reason: A local configuration migration plugin that previews and imports Claude Code skills, rules, commands, and instruction files into DeepSeek Harness with scoped destinations and conflict handling.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 的技能、规则和指令文件预览并导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持用户级或项目级范围及冲突处理。
summaries.en: Preview and import Claude Code skills, rules, and instruction files into DeepSeek Harness with user or project scopes and conflict handling.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code configuration files from user and selected project directories
Writes or merges imported configuration into DeepSeek Harness instruction and skill directories
Previews destinations and conflicts before import
Supports overwrite, merge, skip, and idempotent re-import strategies
